parent_objective: implement bounded source-diverse pairability-grounded history interventions
blocked_by: M1584 design has not yet been implemented
supersedes: training or materialization before source-diverse public intervention evidence

public_gates: M1585 must implement bounded source-edge/window capped pair selection over M1582 pair rows
M1585 must run the pre-registered intervention variants and current-frame controls
M1585 must report public gates, evidence-quality targets, and null taxonomy
M1585 must report high-speed endpoint coverage as diagnostic only
M1585 must keep materialization training PPO promotion and private holdout blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements bounded source-diverse history interventions after pairability-first public pass
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public bounded intervention implementation only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop after one bounded implementation smoke and route to audit
stop if implementation exports training corpus or materializes candidates
stop if implementation changes actor inputs
stop if implementation treats high-speed absence as solved
fallback_plan: route to result audit whether public/evidence gates pass or fail
if selection balance fails, audit pair-row cap and source-edge constraints
if history is null or control-dominated, audit task/variant limitations before another implementation
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1584 admits exactly one bounded implementation smoke

admission_evidence: M1584 pre-registers pair selection, intervention variants, controls, gates, and null taxonomy
allowed_updates: intervention implementation module and focused tests
M1585 status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1585 includes current-frame substitution controls, but any result remains public bounded evidence and must be audited before stronger claims.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1582 pairable reveal and pre-decision anchor windows.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If history interventions are null or control-dominated, record it and route to audit instead of weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: Source-diverse matched-current hidden-divergent pairs can expose history-dependent closed-loop outcome changes beyond current-frame controls.
success_criteria: focused tests cover pair selection and summary gates
selected pair and intervention artifacts exist
public gates and evidence-quality targets are reported
high-speed endpoint coverage is reported as diagnostic only
training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export materialization and self-ID claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: implementation changes actor inputs or uses private holdout
implementation exports a training corpus or starts training/PPO
implementation omits current-frame controls or high-speed caveat
decision_rule: M1585 passes as implementation if it runs bounded public interventions with clean guardrails and writes required metrics; it must still route to audit before materialization or training.
